objective: Test whether a zero-impact, globally learned mixture of the last four frozen AST block representations improves MeowAgeNet age classification over the exact locked final representation.

relationship.known_result: IDEA-065 found that the two-layer probe-guided bottleneck adapter was not stable across deterministic new seeds (mean adapter-minus-head Macro-F1 -0.0057).
relationship.scope: Internal new-seed representation-module screen on the same 792 calls, 111 cats, and formal-v2 nested roles; not external or confirmatory evidence.

validated_local_pdfs.use: AST 12-layer, 768-dimensional encoder and special-token representation geometry.
Task dependence and limitations of simple bottleneck adapters; added convolutional structure introduces new choices.
Mixtures can add complementary capacity but expert, slot, and placement choices create a larger tuning surface.

literature_review.exclusion_reason: The local file has no valid PDF header or EOF and was not used to select layers, formulas, seeds, or gates.

representation.intermediate_layers: Existing float32 cache: common frozen AST final LayerNorm, mean of CLS and distillation tokens, then arithmetic mean across call segments.
representation.final_layer: Exact locked AST pooler_output call embedding replaces cached block-12 values in every last-four tensor.

L1_initialization.required_effect: Exact equality of A0 and L1 representations, logits, and cross-entropy before optimization.

representation.scaling: All pipelines use the training-role mean and standard deviation of exact z12; M0 has no pipeline-specific scaler.

pipeline_definitions.A0_final: Exact locked final AST pooler_output representation.
pipeline_definitions.M0_uniform_last4: Parameter-free uniform average of fixed layers 9-12; secondary mechanism control.
pipeline_definitions.L1_global_layermix: Five-parameter global LayerMix with zero-impact signed residual gate; primary candidate.

model.seed_derivation_rule: Read successive non-overlapping digest uint32 values in big-endian order, reduce modulo 10000, and skip any base/full-seed collision with IDEA-068 through IDEA-076. The first three values were eligible.
model.initialization_fairness: All pipelines have identical initial shared head tensors; A0 and L1 additionally have exact initial logits and loss. Training RNG is reset after construction.

fixed_training.ast_head: training-role z12 standardized 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout
fixed_training.loss: Globally class-balanced call cross-entropy; each complete-cat batch is divided by its call-weight sum.
fixed_training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum unweighted inner-validation animal cross-entropy with a 1e-6 improvement threshold.

aggregation.primary_metric_unit: Nine base-seed-by-repeat estimates per pipeline; each pools the four validation-fold animal records and is then equally weighted.
aggregation.split_cell_unit: Twelve repeat-by-fold cells; each averages the three base-seed paired deltas.
aggregation.descriptive_only: The 36 fold comparisons and repeated validation animal occurrences are descriptive and are not independent samples.
aggregation.M0_role: Secondary mechanism control only; it cannot replace or change the A0-versus-L1 primary gate.

gate.pass_action: Retain L1 as the AST representation-module candidate for a later confirmation or integration study.
gate.fail_action: Report every result and stop this fixed LayerMix formulation without selecting another layer count, gate, seed, or post-outcome variant.
